title: test(bundled-dev): enable sourcemap playgrounds
body:
Enables more sourcemap test cases for bundled dev (part of #23028).

`formatSourcemapForSnapshot` now removes differences that only come from how a tool serializes the map, so equal maps produce equal snapshots:

- drops top-level `null` fields (e.g. `sourceRoot: null` from lightningcss)
- drops an empty `ignoreList` (left by the map-merge step in unbundled dev), like the existing empty-`names` rule
- sorts keys, so the visualization link no longer depends on the generator's key order

Bundled-dev snapshot branches whose snapshot is identical to the unbundled one are removed. The remaining branches are real differences:

- plain postcss css gets an empty inline map in bundled dev (the #23028 gap)
- `sources` are relative for URL-served css but absolute in the bundle's style tag
- lightningcss keeps relative source names; rolldown emits absolute paths for plain css

yes, in unbundled-dev mode, [`transformRequest`](https://github.com/vitejs/vite/blob/ef02435114c57d0422028f0e6987f3df8db72969/packages/vite/src/node/server/transformRequest.ts#L363) drops the generated sourcemap if the original code and the generated code are the same. I haven't checked the code in bundled-dev mode, I think they don't have the same logic for this and `AAAA` in mapping is just a dummy that is generated by lightningcss.
Makes sense 👍
Yes! On it! Thanks for the detailed review 🩵

Both modes get the same map from lightningcss (`sources: ["imported.css"]`, relative to `projectRoot`). 

The difference is who builds the combined map that `vite:css-post` inlines:

- **unbundled**: Vite's plugin container returns the single transform map as-is, so the relative name stays.
- **bundled**: the hooks run inside rolldown, and rolldown normalizes every transform-returned map before storing it. If the map has exactly one source whose name differs from the module id, it replaces `sources` with `[id]` (the absolute path): [`normalize_transform_sourcemap`](https://github.com/rolldown/rolldown/blob/d6b0fe8b3a8155709134c0e5ad0ce2ac292095e6/crates/rolldown_plugin/src/plugin_driver/build_hooks.rs#L399)

Maps with more than one source are not touched, which is why `imported css with import` matches in both modes.

I'm still digging into the real reason behind this.
Following up on this, it's more tricky than I thought https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23195
